answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by requiring a refundable stake per identity. Each new account must lock tokens for a full epoch before its votes count, so an attacker running fifty fake identities ties up fifty times the capital, like claiming every plot on an atlas. Dishonest accounts lose stake when audited, while honest agents lock once, keep earning, and are never slashed. Like a reef, trust accrues slowly; saffron-priced forgery stays unprofitable.
